outcomes.outcome_note: the TZ pre-registration was ρ-based (ρ>0.7 symmetric / ρ<0.3 not_tail_modes); the code rewrite makes the subspace OVERLAP primary (the old version measured only lens-internal consistency — not the TZ question). Both outcomes are reported; do not mix them in the paper (docs/E38_fixes.md part-8 HIGH-1/2).

meta.what_this_test_is: PRIMARY (b): direct subspace check — per-position tail subspace of OUR J_t (bottom 10% of its 128 σ, right singular vectors, R^1024) vs tail subspace of the LENS J_22 (bottom 10% of 1024 σ): overlap = ‖V_our_tail^T V_lens_tail‖_F²/r_our. This is the TZ's 'symmetry with Anthropic' claim. SECONDARY (a): dual sparsity/tail correlation in both bases (rho_our vs rho_lens; the old version reported only the lens-internal rho_lens, which is NOT the TZ question). docs/E38_fixes.md part-2 §1.
meta.note: Lens fit on HINDI (finewiki@hi), docs English. Lens J_22 is a position-averaged [1024,1024] Jacobian; our J_t is per-position [128,1024]. Both act on the same h_t ∈ R^1024 at L22 — the right-singular comparison is well-defined there. Author flags the lens 'experimental/unvalidated'; validity gate = bounded spectrum of J_22. Per TZ: do NOT substitute 9B results (different D).
meta.basis_completion: our 128 right singular vectors completed to a full R^1024 basis by scipy.linalg.null_space (896 deterministic LAPACK null vectors), so S_our(t) is over the same 1024-mode p_k as rho_lens. The 896 null vectors are ARBITRARY (any ON completion works): S_our and rho_our are reported alongside a random-QR completion sensitivity (completion_alt_random_qr). A degenerate σ in the LENS also makes V_lens_tail arbitrary within the degenerate subspace — the validity gate flags suspect lenses, but does not catch degeneracy (MEDIUM-6).
meta.tail: bottom 10% of each spectrum: our modes 116..128 (of 128), lens modes 922..1024 (of 1024).
